card: Plan-branch ledger: the builds census says WHY each build pressed or withheld
guards: builds-census.test 'trace on and off': 6 builds x 3 census seeds hash identically trace on/off, sha256 seed:hash digests equal to values pinned from HEAD 01ada3c before the change, every pre-existing summariseBuild field deep-equal (the hash/digest half was green before by design; the test was red only on the new branches field)
deviations_from_card: 1) The Ring answer reading in builds-census.ts keeps the copied 'pressed' rule: switching it to the traced branch would move the existing answers figures, which case 5 requires unchanged; the pressed-vs-incoming fact is now measured directly as answer:pressed / answer:incoming in branches. 2) Commits are feat+tests together (two green commits, per the card's rollback split) rather than a separate red test commit. 3) runBuildFight gained a 6th positional arg trace=true (needed for the on/off guard). 4) Withholds have a third reason heavy:idle / <archetype>:idle (no legal bolt) beside heavy:waiting / heavy:reserve.
notes: Report line now ends '| why <top3 branches %> | withheld N%'. 20-seed reading: fire_heavy why heavy:waiting 49 heavy:bolt 42 heavy:reserve 4, withheld 55%; air_heavy heavy:reserve 30 heavy:waiting 29 heavy:bolt 26, withheld 60%; fire_light/air_light light:idle 43% (the plan reaches its bolt fallback with no legal bolt - a new finding for census tuning); air_close answer:incoming 7%. planBranches() and whyLine() are standalone exports in builds-census.ts for core-census A to move in wave 4. First gate run hit a sibling's in-flight camp-subtitle.test.ts TS2305; the re-run was green (798 vitest).
